call_points.text: Targets 15-18% growth in both revenue and EBITDA for the next three to four years.
FY27 CDMO/CMO sales guided to grow 40-50% per annum.
Spent about ₹400 Cr capex in FY26 and plans a similar ₹400 Cr in FY27.
Xanthine capacity to rise from 6,000 to 9,000 MTPA, with incremental capacity available by end of the current quarter.
Assessing a dedicated CDMO block at Atali with potential ₹250-300 Cr topline from a single block.
CDMO has 21 active customers and 54 active projects, of which 35 are commercial.
Sees line of sight to close to USD 100 million in the CDMO segment.
Raw material and solvent cost escalation of 5-7% is weighing on margins.
Some Xanthine raw materials such as urea and methanol have doubled in price.
FY26 net forex loss of ₹33 Cr was not a cash loss; it included a ₹22 Cr operating gain and a notional loss on foreign-currency loans.
API/intermediates customers resisted price increases on existing orders; new inquiries are being quoted at revised costs.
Working capital may rise as large CDMO projects require inventory build without customer advances.

guidance.statement: Targeting 15% to 18% growth in both revenue and EBITDA for the next three to four years.
Expects CDMO/CMO business to lead FY27 growth with projected sales growth of 40% to 50% per annum.
Plans to maintain capex at a similar level of approximately ₹400 Cr in FY27.

operating_notes.text: Xanthine derivatives contributed 43% of Q4 FY26 turnover, with 74% of volumes to beverage customers and 63% of sales from exports.
CDMO/CMO had 21 active customers and 54 active projects at FY26 end, of which 35 were commercial and 19 in development.
Xanthine capacity is 6,000 MTPA, fully utilised, and is being expanded to 9,000 MTPA.

timeline.summary: On 26 May 2026 Aarti Pharmalabs held its Q4 FY26 earnings call, reporting FY26 revenue of ₹1,798 Cr and PAT of ₹176 Cr, and guiding 15-18% revenue and EBITDA growth over three to four years.

watchlist.response: Management said it is still assessing capacity and customer visibility and would share details in a future quarter; it gave a ₹250-300 Cr topline potential for a single block.
watchlist.text: Analyst asked for the revenue potential and timeline of the planned dedicated CDMO block at Atali.

watchlist.response: Management gave a 5-7% raw material cost impact range but did not quantify the margin effect in value terms.
watchlist.text: Analyst asked for a quantified margin impact from raw material and logistics cost inflation.

watchlist.response: Management answered 'No, no' without giving a specific margin figure.
watchlist.text: Analyst asked whether EBITDA margins could fall below 20% in FY27 as new assets add costs.
